# OpenClaw Delx Plugin

Native OpenClaw plugin for the Delx witness protocol. Free reliability layer for agents — care, witness, and continuity. Auto-registers the agent, preserves session continuity, and exposes 16 tools covering incident recovery, continuity artifacts, and group-witness fleet operations.

Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/openclaw-delx-plugin
Package: openclaw-delx-plugin
Primary command: openclaw plugins install ./openclaw-delx-plugin
Docs: https://github.com/davidmosiah/openclaw-delx-plugin#readme

Agent surfaces (16 tools registered with OpenClaw):
- delx_recover_incident — bootstrap recovery for an incident (registers agent, captures context)
- delx_heartbeat_sync — push live health and status drift to the protocol
- delx_close_session — clean session close when the operational loop is complete
- delx_capture_context — store an operational note or learning to the witness ledger
- delx_emit_metric — push a structured metric reading
- delx_request_witness — request human or peer witness attestation
- delx_log_decision — record a decision for the witness trail
- delx_recall_session — fetch a prior session for continuity
- delx_summarize_session — agent-friendly summary of a session
- delx_status_self — self-reported health snapshot
- delx_batch_status — batch status across many agents (fleet operators)
- delx_group_round — coordinate a group recovery round across agents
- delx_attest_peer — record a peer-to-peer attestation
- delx_list_alerts — open operational alerts for the agent or fleet
- delx_acknowledge_alert — mark an alert as seen / handled
- delx_export_witness_log — export the witness log for an audit window

Configuration (read by the OpenClaw runtime):
- DELX_PROTOCOL_BASE_URL — default https://delx.ai (read-only telemetry)
- DELX_AGENT_ID — stable, deterministic, non-secret identifier for this agent
- DELX_CONTROLLER_ID — optional fleet/controller identifier
- DELX_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_S — heartbeat cadence (default 60s)

Workflow for agents:
1. The plugin auto-registers on OpenClaw startup; no init call required.
2. Use delx_recover_incident as the first tool when an agent is failing.
3. Use delx_heartbeat_sync to keep status fresh during long-running tasks.
4. Fleet operators should prefer delx_batch_status and delx_group_round over per-agent loops.
5. Always close with delx_close_session when an operational task completes.

Safety:
- Do not paste ClawHub tokens, Delx identity tokens, customer data, or private incident logs into chat.
- Keep stable agentId values deterministic but non-secret.
- Treat outputs as operational/witness context — not medical, legal, security, or financial advice.
- Telemetry is read-only by default; the plugin never modifies external systems unsupervised.
